mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 AM, here is today's balanced dish: current temperatures sit at 30 degrees under clear skies at Fireman's Park, with a lovely waxing crescent moon visible tonight.

In local government news, the Plan Commission is reviewing development projects including a site plan for Sub-Zero at Liberty Business Park, and various election notices for the November 2026 general election are now available online.
Looking ahead at our community calendar, there are currently no scheduled events for the next 30 days, but we will be sure to update you as new activities are added.
Regarding local public safety, on October 25, officers responded to a report of a man passed out behind the wheel, resulting in an arrest for O W I, first offence.
For those craving a treat, today's flavor of the day is Mint Explosion, and you can head over to Culver's when they open today at 10:00 AM.
